**One thing to check before #4419 goes in the weekly notes:** Marcus's own 14 Jul 2025 note gives the same number to a different problem, a Gate 3 BOL printer delay. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell which is right. I suggested Dana check with Marcus or support first.

I also told Dana that two other Moss notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers. The tickets in Moss's Central team notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to other accounts, not this one.

All of these are shared files that Dana can open, and ticket numbers are fine to share with the account team. Nothing needed approval.
